The VFD is reset and the heating zone is heating up.
Do we know why this was not heating?

Hi Team,
One of the temperature control units was not heating the coconut oil line, causing the oil to solidify inside the pipe. As a result, the system automatically activated the pump protection to prevent the pump from overloading and getting damaged.

We restarted the heating unit and then called Maintenance to reset the pump protection.

We are now back up and running. Justin Garner Chris Jeffs Chris Givens
